g.text: 6 Find the bracket holes by counting from the edges
Top view • actual retained chassis section • orange circles are the 16 bracket screw holes
Use them to orient the plate.
Each bracket uses four holes in a 16 × 16 mm square; hole-grid spacing is 8 mm.
Orange rectangles show bracket feet. Their outer faces extend 12 mm beyond the chassis side edges.
The foot points inward. The upright stands outside the plate; do not set it flush against the plate edge.
Coordinates in the guide are millimetres from the centre, not row numbers. Bracket centres are NOT screw holes.
Front bracket centre: X=+32, between rows 8/10. Rear bracket centre: X=−16, between rows 14/16.
P1 Track carrier: track_carrier_s1.stl | P2 Fixed bracket: fixed_bracket_s1.stl
S0/S1 candidate • simplified assembly illustration • dimensions in mm • not a fabrication template
